note: Operational configuration of this repository, not published metadata: it says which upstream release feeds which source, which package names that source carries, and which meta package stands for a family of them. Nothing verifies against it and no client reads it — the signed documents inside each source are what count.

build-tools.description: The build environment's host tools, one package per platform: the compiler toolchain, the build system, the workspace tool and the wheel set the build's virtual environment is created from. Published with a meta package under the family name, which a build pins instead of one platform's package.
build-tools.title: MCUHome build tools

build-workspace.description: The build environment's source world, architecture-neutral: the framework and its dependencies at pinned revisions, the base patches applied, the blobs fetched and the generated code that is a release constant already generated.
build-workspace.title: MCUHome build workspace

sdk.description: The source package a build compiles from: the Zephyr module, the C runtime, the components and the code generator.
sdk.title: MCUHome SDK
